query: How should we construct and validate leave-one-out shift-share instruments and pre-specify alternative constructions to minimise endogenous exposure and mechanical correlation?

response.query: How should we construct and validate leave-one-out shift-share instruments and pre-specify alternative constructions to minimise endogenous exposure and mechanical correlation?
response.answer: To construct leave-one-out shift-share instruments, use exogenous variables unaffected by the treatment. Validate instruments with overidentification tests and robustness checks. Pre-specify alternative instruments to minimize endogenous exposure and mechanical correlation.
